title: 17 Filipinos on tanker that hit New Orleans river cruise boat safe — Cacdac
summary: All 17 Filipino seafarers on the Marshall Islands-flagged vessel Atlantic Asphalt that crashed into a docked river cruise boat in Louisiana in the US are safe, DMW Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac announced…

blocks.text: All 17 Filipino seafarers on the Marshall Islands-flagged vessel Atlantic Asphalt that crashed into a docked river cruise boat in Louisiana in the US are safe, DMW Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac announced Sunday, November 15.
